This suggests that the `dt.tz_convert` method is incorrectly handling the datetime values with timezone information when applied to a categorical Series.

Upon further investigation, it appears that the issue lies in the fact that the `dt.tz_convert` method is not correctly handling the case where the series has multiple unique datetime values but different timezones. In this case, the `dt.tz_convert` method should return a new series with the correct timezone information for each unique datetime value.

The root cause of the issue appears to be that the `dt.tz_convert` method is not correctly handling the conversion of datetime values from one timezone to another when applied to a categorical Series. This is due to an error in the implementation of this method, which needs to be corrected.
